Specification: This module specifies a round-based distributed algorithm for computing a maximal independent set on a ring-like network of nodes. The graph is modeled by an undirected neighbor relation, nodes exchange variant-tagged messages over three rounds, and each node may become a winner, a loser, or remain unknown while maintaining a set of remaining neighbors. The specification includes an explicit fault-injection design choice through the constant HAS_BUG, which alters the winner test to always succeed when enabled; the file defines initialization, round actions, the next-state relation, and state predicates including an independence condition and a termination condition.
IfThenElse: IF n > 1 THEN n - 1 ELSE N
IF n < N THEN n + 1 ELSE 1
IF HAS_BUG THEN TRUE ELSE val'[u] > m.val
IF awake[n] /\ IsWinner(n) THEN "winner" ELSE status[n]
IF \E w \in Senders(u): awake[w] /\ status[w] = "winner" THEN { Winner(u) } ELSE {}
IF awake[n] /\ IsLoser(n) THEN "loser" ELSE status[n]
IF status[n] \notin {"winner", "loser"} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
